About

My name is Atis Manustrakan, and I am a Computer Science student at the University of Central Florida.

I enjoy building software and learning more about backend development, full-stack applications, AI, and how large systems work. I primarily work with Java, Python, and C, and I’ve also built projects using React, Node.js, and APIs.

Outside of computer science, I enjoy basketball, poker, guitar, and piano, and I’ve also developed an interest in finance.

I’m always looking to learn something new, whether that’s through personal projects, research, or working with others.

I hope this website gives you a glimpse into my journey in computer science and the things I enjoy outside of it. Thanks for visiting!

View project ↗GitHub ↗

Live AI API features are temporarily unavailable because API usage costs are not currently funded.

Technical notes

The C core handles calorie targets, macro calculations, and meal logging. Node.js and Express connect the web interface to USDA food data, Supabase, and AI-ready workflows.

Challenge: keeping calculation logic independent from the interface while combining user input, external data, and AI-generated output.
